text.description_html:
Fusion TR-A6, River Rock Hand Towel Ring with Round Mounts

Looking for a finishing touch that will really elevate your bathroom's overall style? Then the Round Mount River Rock Towel Ring is for you. Not to be cheesy, but this towel ring is a great way to add traditional beauty without aging your space. We've all seen that bathroom hardware that is supposed to be classic yet screams 1989. Made by Fusion, the TR-A6 River Rock Hand Towel Ring with Round Mounts is a shining example of how simplicity can be beautiful as well as timeless. Choose from medium bronze or dark bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-A6 Bronze River Rock Towel Bar, Fusion PH-A6 Bronze River Rock Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-A6 Bronze River Rock Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Bronze Round Radius Hand Towel Ring:

  • Mount Diameter: 3"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
